name: SEOUL 1988 Black Ginseng Retinal Cream | Anti-Aging Cream with Liposomal Retinal, Black Ginseng & Bakuchiol | Helps Reduce Wrinkles & Dark Spots | Korean Skincare
description:
Reveal smoother, firmer, and healthier-looking skin with SEOUL 1988 Black Ginseng Retinal Cream. Formulated with Liposomal Retinal, Black Ginseng, Niacinamide, and Bakuchiol, this advanced Korean skincare cream helps improve the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles, dark spots, and uneven texture while being gentler than traditional retinol formulas.

Key Features
Enriched with Liposomal Retinal and Black Ginseng
Helps reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles
Supports collagen production and skin renewal
Helps improve skin texture and firmness
Niacinamide helps brighten dull skin and minimize pores
Bakuchiol supports anti-aging benefits with less irritation
Lightweight formula absorbs quickly into the skin
Helps improve overall skin elasticity
Gentle formula designed for nighttime use
Suitable for all skin types

Product Specifications
Product Type: Anti-Aging Face Cream
Texture: Cream
Usage Time: PM (Night Use)
Skin Type: All Skin Types
Category: Korean Skincare
Finish: Non-greasy

How to Use
Apply a pea-sized amount to clean, dry skin at night
Start by using 2–3 times per week
Gradually increase usage to every night
Follow with moisturizer if needed
Apply sunscreen the next morning
Avoid using with Vitamin C or exfoliating acids (AHA/BHA)

Material / Composition
Liposomal Retinal
Black Ginseng Extract
Niacinamide
Bakuchiol
Hydrating and skin-conditioning ingredients

Safety Information
For external use only
Avoid contact with eyes
Keep out of reach of children
Discontinue use if irritation occurs
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight

1 × SEOUL 1988 Black Ginseng Retinal Cream
